Implemented both improvements:

- Pasting a URL now automatically fetches its page title and description.
- Metadata remains editable before saving.
- Title is no longer required; the domain is used as a fallback.
- New bookmarks default to unread.
- Added a dedicated Unread view with a live count.
- Each card now has a one-click Read/Unread toggle.
- Unread status is preserved when editing and stored locally.

Verified metadata retrieval against a live public page. The updated app is available at [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000).
